answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the delta of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
